public_rationale: The evidence establishes substantial price competition during the period Marcus describes. Reuters documented deep cuts and rapid responses among major Chinese providers. Google's own announcement confirms large reductions for an existing model. The claim does not require every model's price to fall or competition to explain every reduction.
limitations: The clearest evidence of directly responsive price cutting concerns China.
Price reductions can also reflect efficiency improvements.
These examples do not measure an industry-wide average price change.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Price wars among LLM providers have been significant.

statement.excerpt: In my view, the world has indeed gone in this direction. LLMs have become commodities, prices wars have been significant, profits for the LLM providers have been elusive.

our_interpretation: Read prices wars as price wars.
The plain reading is substantial competitive price cutting among LLM providers, rather than a claim that every provider or model became cheaper.
Use January 2024 through publication because Marcus explicitly compares developments with his January 2024 warning.
This concerns market pricing behavior, not a particular company's financial accounts; metric_scope is therefore null.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records show substantial price cuts by major LLM providers and competitive responses or credible reporting connecting those cuts to rivalry.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative pricing histories show no substantial competitive cuts during the period, or establish that the alleged cuts were merely incomparable product changes.
